title: HSBar 솔로 #083 · 폴리네시안여신 · Peruvian Nazca painted pattern · 황동 바 결박 · glossy candy-pink lips
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Japanese woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair skin, bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart stickers on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips, a quietly weary look, heavy eyelids and a faint tension at the corners of her lips, warm honey-blonde hair styled in elegant updo, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glittery finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern — a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures, wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense stepped geometric borders filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. The painted surface is scuffed and dulled along her hips, calves and forearms, rubbed away in a few worn patches at her elbows, inner thighs and ankles so her skin tone shows through, with flakes of pigment lifting at the edges. Dust and soot streak her temples and jaw, her lipstick is faded and smudged, dark smears run along her ribs, arms and shins, and her bare feet are filthy with dust and dirt.

Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto a thick straight round bar of aged brass with a green verdigris patina that spans the full width of the chamber from one stone wall to the other, both ends set deep into the stone blocks, at a height just above her raised hands, the cuffs sitting snug against the metal, her wrists a little wider apart than her shoulders and her arms raised straight up. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto a second straight round aged brass bar that spans from wall to wall along the flagstone floor, both ends set deep into the stone blocks, the cuffs sitting snug against the metal, her feet spread about shoulder-width apart.

Pose: standing full height between the supports, facing the camera, her arms raised straight up with her hands hanging limp and loose from the cuffs, fingers softly curled and relaxed, her head tipped very slightly forward, her bare feet spread about shoulder-width apart flat on the flagstones, her whole body sagging a little with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background & Lighting: the dim light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
